turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: So Gemini 4 Argon. Google's own blog describes it as their most powerful frontier model to date. Not available to you, not available to most developers. Only to a vetted group of cyber defenders inside something called the Fairwind Program. Rufus, what does that framing tell you?

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: It tells you that the most consequential capability is also the one Google trusts the fewest people to hold.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: Which they're calling safety-first. I'd like to know the criteria for being vetted, because that's doing a lot of work in that sentence.
